run_upload_gtest: run upload_gtest.py to upload a Google Test patch for review with default cc list
run_upload_gtest_with_cc: run upload_gtest.py with --cc flag to add custom reviewers to the patch review
run_upload_gtest_append_cc: run upload_gtest.py with --cc to append googletestframework@googlegroups.com to existing cc list
run_upload_gtest_pass_flags: run upload_gtest.py passing arbitrary upload.py command line flags through to upload.py
summarize_upload_gtest: summarize how upload_gtest.py wraps upload.py and auto-ccs the googletest discussion group
